source.code:
/--
`LawfulRightIdentify op o` indicates `o` is a verified right identity of
`op`.
-/
class LawfulRightIdentity (op : α → β → α) (o : outParam β) : Prop extends RightIdentity op o where
  /-- Right identity `o` is an identity. -/
  right_id : ∀ a, op a o = a
